# Each vector tail must load exactly once through its masked loader:
# one masked mnemonic per sum function (the tail), none in the body.
# The double pattern fails when a second masked load appears.
[!GOARCH:amd64] skip 'tail-once objdump needs amd64'

env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
env GOEXPERIMENT=simd
env GOAMD64=v1

cd m
logos build -o $WORK/exe .
logos run .
stdout '^sums ok$'

go tool objdump -s '^main\.sumI32$' $WORK/exe
stdout 'VPMASKMOVD'
! stdout '(?s)VPMASKMOVD.*VPMASKMOVD'

go tool objdump -s '^main\.sumU32$' $WORK/exe
stdout 'VPMASKMOVD'
! stdout '(?s)VPMASKMOVD.*VPMASKMOVD'

go tool objdump -s '^main\.sumF32$' $WORK/exe
stdout 'VPMASKMOVD'
! stdout '(?s)VPMASKMOVD.*VPMASKMOVD'

go tool objdump -s '^main\.sumU64$' $WORK/exe
stdout 'VPMASKMOVQ'
! stdout '(?s)VPMASKMOVQ.*VPMASKMOVQ'

go tool objdump -s '^main\.sumI64$' $WORK/exe
stdout 'VPMASKMOVQ'
! stdout '(?s)VPMASKMOVQ.*VPMASKMOVQ'

go tool objdump -s '^main\.sumF64$' $WORK/exe
stdout 'VPMASKMOVQ'
! stdout '(?s)VPMASKMOVQ.*VPMASKMOVQ'

go tool objdump -s '^main\.sumAlias$' $WORK/exe
stdout 'VPMASKMOVQ'
! stdout '(?s)VPMASKMOVQ.*VPMASKMOVQ'

go tool objdump -s '^main\.sumU16$' $WORK/exe
stdout 'VMOVDQU16\.Z'
! stdout '(?s)VMOVDQU16\.Z.*VMOVDQU16\.Z'

go tool objdump -s '^main\.sumI16$' $WORK/exe
stdout 'VMOVDQU16\.Z'
! stdout '(?s)VMOVDQU16\.Z.*VMOVDQU16\.Z'

go tool objdump -s '^main\.sumU8$' $WORK/exe
stdout 'VMOVDQU8\.Z'
! stdout '(?s)VMOVDQU8\.Z.*VMOVDQU8\.Z'

go tool objdump -s '^main\.sumI8$' $WORK/exe
stdout 'VMOVDQU8\.Z'
! stdout '(?s)VMOVDQU8\.Z.*VMOVDQU8\.Z'

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/tailonce

go 1.27

-- m/main.lgo --
package main

import "fmt"

//go:noinline
func sumI32(xs []int32) int32 { return xs.sum() }

//go:noinline
func sumU32(xs []uint32) uint32 { return xs.sum() }

//go:noinline
func sumF32(xs []float32) float32 { return xs.sum() }

//go:noinline
func sumU64(xs []uint64) uint64 { return xs.sum() }

//go:noinline
func sumI64(xs []int64) int64 { return xs.sum() }

//go:noinline
func sumF64(xs []float64) float64 { return xs.sum() }

type watt = float64

//go:noinline
func sumAlias(xs []watt) float64 { return xs.sum() }

//go:noinline
func sumU16(xs []uint16) uint16 { return xs.sum() }

//go:noinline
func sumI16(xs []int16) int16 { return xs.sum() }

//go:noinline
func sumU8(xs []uint8) uint8 { return xs.sum() }

//go:noinline
func sumI8(xs []int8) int8 { return xs.sum() }

func main() {
	if sumI32([]int32{1, 2, 3}) != 6 {
		panic("i32")
	}
	if sumU32([]uint32{1, 2, 3}) != 6 {
		panic("u32")
	}
	if sumF32([]float32{1, 2, 3}) != 6 {
		panic("f32")
	}
	if sumU64([]uint64{1, 2, 3}) != 6 {
		panic("u64")
	}
	if sumI64([]int64{1, 2, 3}) != 6 {
		panic("i64")
	}
	if sumF64([]float64{1, 2, 3}) != 6 {
		panic("f64")
	}
	if sumAlias([]watt{1, 2, 3}) != 6 {
		panic("alias")
	}
	if sumU16([]uint16{1, 2, 3}) != 6 {
		panic("u16")
	}
	if sumI16([]int16{1, 2, 3}) != 6 {
		panic("i16")
	}
	if sumU8([]uint8{1, 2, 3}) != 6 {
		panic("u8")
	}
	if sumI8([]int8{1, 2, 3}) != 6 {
		panic("i8")
	}
	fmt.Println("sums ok")
}
